summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing for GeoTag Verval DTSEN feature. Tested login/routing, RBAC enforcement, verval operator workflow, review/penugasan pages, and Peta Kemiskinan with Google Maps basemap integration. All critical features working correctly.
passed_tests: LOGIN & ROUTING: operator_rt_rw login successful, sidebar displays 'Verval DTSEN' group with 'Verval Operator' item, navigates to /verval showing 2 KK UJI sasaran
RBAC ROUTING (operator_rt_rw): Correctly redirected from /verval/review and /verval/penugasan to /dashboard (cannot access reviewer/admin pages)
RBAC ROUTING (verifikator): Can access /verval/review, sidebar shows 'Review Hasil Verval', correctly redirected from /verval (not operator)
RBAC ROUTING (admin/superadmin): Sidebar shows both 'Penugasan Operator' and 'Review Hasil Verval', can access both /verval/penugasan and /verval/review
VERVAL OPERATOR FLOW: Draft creation works, all 5 step tabs (0-4) visible, can navigate and fill 8 indikator fields with 'sesuai' results
VERVAL VALIDATION: Kekurangan section correctly shows missing foto/GPS requirements, 'Kirim' button properly disabled when requirements not met, 'Simpan draft' button works
VERVAL REVIEW: Verifikator can access /verval/review page, status filter dropdown works, UI does not crash when changing filters
VERVAL PENUGASAN: Admin can access /verval/penugasan, forms (operator, kelurahan, RW, RT) visible, table displays 3 seeded UJI penugasan (op.rtrw.a in Kaluku Bodoa, op.rtrw.b in Buloa)
PETA KEMISKINAN: Page loads without runtime errors, no 'topright' error found, Leaflet map canvas renders correctly
VERVAL MAP LAYER: Panel visible at bottom-left (data-testid='verval-map-layer'), shows count badge, expand/collapse button works correctly
GOOGLE BASEMAP INTEGRATION: Leaflet layer control visible at top-right, all basemap options present (OpenStreetMap, Google Road, Google Satellite, Google Hybrid)
GOOGLE BASEMAP SWITCHING: Successfully switched to Google Satellite basemap, map continues to render without crashes
VERVAL MAP LAYER (operator_rt_rw): Panel visible with mode 'titik', toggle checkbox works, can toggle layer on/off, count badge shows 0 (no submitted data yet)
